collection.title: Saab 9-3 Hatchback 2005 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Saab 9-3 Hatchback Mk2 2005 to 2006 will fit, this model requires a 23" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade
